title: Full-Stack Engineers (React/Node)
description:
Main Responsibilities – Engineering Team
 

  • Maintenance and further development of existing platform services
  • Development of new backend features and services
  • Backend development with TypeScript, Node.js and NestJS
  • Development and operation of AWS-based services
  • Working with microservice and event-driven architectures
  • Taking ownership of existing production services
  • Analysis and reverse engineering of existing applications
  • Working with legacy code and historically grown systems
  • Production troubleshooting and incident resolution
  • Ensuring stability and reliability of production applications
  • DevOps and operations activities
  • Monitoring, logging and observability
  • Technical modernization and reduction of technical debt
  • Performance optimization
  • Proactive identification of architectural and operational improvements
  • Selected frontend/full-stack tasks using React



Critical Must-Haves – Engineering Team

  • TypeScript
  • Node.js
  • NestJS
  • AWS
  • Microservices
  • Event-driven architectures
  • AWS EventBridge
  • AWS SQS
  • PostgreSQL
  • Production cloud applications
  • Legacy systems
  • Reverse engineering
  • Modernization of existing applications
  • DevOps
  • Operations
  • Incident Management
  • Production troubleshooting
  • Monitoring
  • Observability
  • Experience taking ownership of existing production services
  • High seniority level across the team
  • React - required within the team: at least 1–2 engineers must be able to cover React-based full-stack tasks.

    This is primarily a backend/platform project, not a classical full-stack project.

    Start: mid-October/November
    Duration: 6 months + possible extension
    Workload: By agreement, 120–160 hours/month per resource, depending on the proposed profile and team composition
    Team size: 4 developers + 1 Engineering Manager, 5 people in total
    Location: EU (remote) !!!
    Language: English
